title: Aggressive Maneuvers for Autonomous Quadrotor Flight
summary: A demonstration from UPenn's GRASP Lab of an autonomous quadrotor performing flips, flying through windows and perching on surfaces. It shows precise aggressive maneuvering control of a small UAV.
why: Cited as a landmark demonstration of how capable autonomous drones had become, mostly in threads about drone delivery, swarms and drone warfare.

quote.text: The real takeaway is the radical increase in the abilities of flying drones
